 The Atlas Lions held their second training session in Maâmora on 10 November. They are due to play in Casablanca on 13 November, then in Rabat on 17 November.
 Rieltony LOUBOKO · Author profile · 11/11/2026 09:50 UTC

The Atlas Lions held their second training session on 10 November at the Mohammed VI Football Complex in Maâmora, led by Mohamed Ouahbi and his staff. Morocco are preparing for two matches against Niger on matchdays 3 and 4 of qualifying for the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations.
 For 90 minutes, the squad worked on ball circulation, team play and tactical organisation. The session also covered physical and technical work, with every member of the squad involved on the pitch.
 Achraf Hakimi was applauded by his team-mates after being named in the FIFPRO 2026 World XI.
 The first match is scheduled for 13 November in Casablanca, where Morocco will take on Niger. The second meeting between the two teams is set for 17 November in Rabat. Niger will be the Atlas Lions’ opponents on both occasions, first in Casablanca and then in Rabat.
